title: China Autumn Travel Map
synopsis: During autumn in China, you can enjoy the red leaves in Beijing’s Fragrant Hills, the sea of clouds at Huangshan, and delicious Chengdu hotpot. This article recommends some great choices for travel in China to enjoy the beautiful scenery and pleasant weather of autumn.

fullText.simplified:
中国秋季旅游地图

    秋天是一个特别的季节，没有夏天的热情，但是有不同的颜色；没有冬天的安静，但是有让人舒服的天气。中国的秋天怎么样，可以去下面几个城市看看。
    如果要在中国找秋天，不能错过北京。北京的秋天很有名，有太多人写过北京的秋天了。秋天的北京，天非常蓝，也非常高，天气不冷不热。所以很多人会在这个时候去爬山，北京香山是第一选择。香山的树在秋天会变成红色，红红的树、蓝蓝的天，美极了。故宫也很不错，在这段时间，学生们都回到学校上课了，来看故宫的人不太多。又漂亮又安静的故宫，不要错过。
    南方的秋天也很美，可以去黄山看看。黄山在安徽，安徽在中国南方。中国有这样的说法：去过黄山以后，你就不想再爬山了。这是因为中国人觉得黄山是中国最漂亮的山。黄山很高，山上有很多特别的树和石头。山上的云也非常好看，像大海一样，站在山上看云海，是来黄山一定要做的事情。如果不想太累，也可以在山下看黄色、红色的树，旁边还有白色的老房子，这是几百年前中国的样子，电影《卧虎藏龙》里就有这些房子和树。
    如果想去中国西边找秋天，可以去成都。成都是一个火辣的城市，如果你怕热，那在秋天去成都是最好的选择。成都的秋天不像夏天的那么热，天气舒服极了。这时去成都一定要吃一次火锅。成都火锅很好吃，但是有点辣。这时候的成都市里有很多漂亮的树，黄的、绿的、红的……如果不想在市里玩，可以去爬雪山，但是别忘了多带一些衣服。
    东、西、南、北，每个地方的秋天都不太一样，除了这三个地方，中国还有很多地方的秋天都很漂亮。如果有时间，可以去更多的地方看看。
fullText.traditional:
中國秋季旅遊地圖

    秋天是一個特別的季節，沒有夏天的熱情，但是有不同的顏色；沒有冬天的安靜，但是有讓人舒服的天氣。中國的秋天怎麼樣，可以去下面幾個城市看看。
    如果要在中國找秋天，不能錯過北京。北京的秋天很有名，有太多人寫過北京的秋天了。秋天的北京，天非常藍，也非常高，天氣不冷不熱。所以很多人會在這個時候去爬山，北京香山是第一選擇。香山的樹在秋天會變成紅色，紅紅的樹、藍藍的天，美極了。故宮也很不錯，在這段時間，學生們都回到學校上課了，來看故宮的人不太多。又漂亮又安靜的故宮，不要錯過。
    南方的秋天也很美，可以去黃山看看。黃山在安徽，安徽在中國南方。中國有這樣的說法：去過黃山以後，你就不想再爬山了。這是因為中國人覺得黃山是中國最漂亮的山。黃山很高，山上有很多特別的樹和石頭。山上的雲也非常好看，像大海一樣，站在山上看雲海，是來黃山一定要做的事情。如果不想太累，也可以在山下看黃色、紅色的樹，旁邊還有白色的老房子，這是幾百年前中國的樣子，電影《臥虎藏龍》裡就有這些房子和樹。
    如果想去中國西邊找秋天，可以去成都。成都是一個火辣的城市，如果你怕熱，那在秋天去成都是最好的選擇。成都的秋天不像夏天的那麼熱，天氣舒服極了。這時去成都一定要吃一次火鍋。成都火鍋很好吃，但是有點辣。這時候的成都市裡有很多漂亮的樹，黃的、綠的、紅的……如果不想在市裡玩，可以去爬雪山，但是別忘了多帶一些衣服。
    東、西、南、北，每個地方的秋天都不太一樣，除了這三個地方，中國還有很多地方的秋天都很漂亮。如果有時間，可以去更多的地方看看。

sentences.english: China Autumn Travel Map

sentences.simplified: 秋天是一个特别的季节，没有夏天的热情，但是有不同的颜色；
sentences.traditional: 秋天是一個特別的季節，沒有夏天的熱情，但是有不同的顏色；
sentences.pinyin: qiū tiān shì yí ge tè bié de jì jié méi yǒu xià tiān de rè qíng dàn shì yǒu bù tóng de yán sè

sentences.simplified: 没有冬天的安静，但是有让人舒服的天气。
sentences.traditional: 沒有冬天的安靜，但是有讓人舒服的天氣。
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu dōng tiān de ān jìng dàn shì yǒu ràng rén shū fu de tiān qì
sentences.english: Autumn is a special season. It doesn’t have the passion of summer, but it has a different color.

sentences.simplified: 中国的秋天怎么样，可以去下面几个城市看看。
sentences.traditional: 中國的秋天怎麼樣，可以去下面幾個城市看看。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó de qiū tiān zěn me yàng kě yǐ qù xià miàn jǐ ge chéng shì kàn kan
sentences.english: It doesn’t have the quietness of winter, but its weather makes people feel comfortable.
What is autumn like in China? Let’s take a look at the following cities.

sentences.simplified: 如果要在中国找秋天，不能错过北京。
sentences.traditional: 如果要在中國找秋天，不能錯過北京。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ yào zài zhōng guó zhǎo qiū tiān bù néng cuò guò běi jīng

sentences.simplified: 北京的秋天很有名，有太多人写过北京的秋天了。
sentences.traditional: 北京的秋天很有名，有太多人寫過北京的秋天了。
sentences.pinyin: běi jīng de qiū tiān hěn yǒu míng yǒu tài duō rén xiě guò běi jīng de qiū tiān le
sentences.english: If you want to look for autumn in China, you should not miss Beijing.

sentences.simplified: 秋天的北京，天非常蓝，也非常高，天气不冷不热。
sentences.traditional: 秋天的北京，天非常藍，也非常高，天氣不冷不熱。
sentences.pinyin: qiū tiān de běi jīng tiān fēi cháng lán yě fēi cháng gāo tiān qì bù lěng bú rè
sentences.english: Autumn in Beijing is very famous. Many people have written about Beijing’s autumn.

sentences.simplified: 所以很多人会在这个时候去爬山，北京香山是第一选择。
sentences.traditional: 所以很多人會在這個時候去爬山，北京香山是第一選擇。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ hěn duō rén huì zài zhè ge shí hou qù pá shān běi jīng xiāng shān shì dì yī xuǎn zé
sentences.english: In autumn, the sky in Beijing is very blue and very high, and the weather is neither cold nor hot.

sentences.simplified: 香山的树在秋天会变成红色，红红的树、蓝蓝的天，美极了。
sentences.traditional: 香山的樹在秋天會變成紅色，紅紅的樹、藍藍的天，美極了。
sentences.pinyin: xiāng shān de shù zài qiū tiān huì biàn chéng hóng sè hóng hóng de shù lán lán de tiān měi jí le
sentences.english: So many people will go hiking during this time, and Beijing’s Fragrant Hills are the top choice.

sentences.simplified: 故宫也很不错，
sentences.traditional: 故宮也很不錯，
sentences.pinyin: gù gōng yě hěn bú cuò
sentences.english: The trees in the Fragrant Hills turn red in autumn. The red trees and the blue skies are incredibly beautiful.

sentences.simplified: 在这段时间，学生们都回到学校上课了，来看故宫的人不太多。
sentences.traditional: 在這段時間，學生們都回到學校上課了，來看故宮的人不太多。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè duàn shí jiān xué sheng men dōu huí dào xué xiào shàng kè le lái kàn gù gōng de rén bú tài duō
sentences.english: The Forbidden City is also great.

sentences.simplified: 又漂亮又安静的故宫，不要错过。
sentences.traditional: 又漂亮又安靜的故宮，不要錯過。
sentences.pinyin: yòu piào liang yòu ān jìng de gù gōng bú yào cuò guò
sentences.english: During this period, students have returned to school for classes, so there aren’t too many people visiting the Forbidden City.
You should not miss the beautiful and tranquil Forbidden City.

sentences.simplified: 南方的秋天也很美，可以去黄山看看。
sentences.traditional: 南方的秋天也很美，可以去黃山看看。
sentences.pinyin: nán fāng de qiū tiān yě hěn měi kě yǐ qù huáng shān kàn kan

sentences.simplified: 黄山在安徽，安徽在中国南方。
sentences.traditional: 黃山在安徽，安徽在中國南方。
sentences.pinyin: huáng shān zài ān huī ān huī zài zhōng guó nán fāng
sentences.english: Autumn in the south is also very beautiful. You can go to Huangshan to have a look.

sentences.simplified: 中国有这样的说法：去过黄山以后，你就不想再爬山了。
sentences.traditional: 中國有這樣的說法：去過黃山以後，你就不想再爬山了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó yǒu zhè yàng de shuō fa qù guò huáng shān yǐ hòu nǐ jiù bù xiǎng zài pá shān le
sentences.english: Huangshan is in Anhui, which is in southern China.

sentences.simplified: 这是因为中国人觉得黄山是中国最漂亮的山。
sentences.traditional: 這是因為中國人覺得黃山是中國最漂亮的山。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì yīn wèi zhōng guó rén jué de huáng shān shì zhōng guó zuì piào liang de shān
sentences.english: In China, there is a saying: After visiting Huangshan, you won’t want to climb any other mountains.

sentences.simplified: 黄山很高，山上有很多特别的树和石头。
sentences.traditional: 黃山很高，山上有很多特別的樹和石頭。
sentences.pinyin: huáng shān hěn gāo shān shang yǒu hěn duō tè bié de shù hé shí tou
sentences.english: This is because Chinese people consider Huangshan to be the most beautiful mountain in China.

sentences.simplified: 山上的云也非常好看，像大海一样，
sentences.traditional: 山上的雲也非常好看，像大海一樣，
sentences.pinyin: shān shang de yún yě fēi cháng hǎo kàn xiàng dà hǎi yí yàng
sentences.english: Huangshan is very high. There are many special trees and rocks on the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 站在山上看云海，是来黄山一定要做的事情。
sentences.traditional: 站在山上看雲海，是來黃山一定要做的事情。
sentences.pinyin: zhàn zài shān shang kàn yún hǎi shì lái huáng shān yí dìng yào zuò de shì qing
sentences.english: The clouds on the mountain are also incredibly beautiful, like the sea.

sentences.simplified: 如果不想太累，也可以在山下看黄色、红色的树，
sentences.traditional: 如果不想太累，也可以在山下看黃色、紅色的樹，
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ bù xiǎng tài lèi yě kě yǐ zài shān xià kàn huáng sè hóng sè de shù
sentences.english: Standing on the mountain and watching the sea of clouds is a must-do activity when visiting Huangshan.

sentences.simplified: 旁边还有白色的老房子，这是几百年前中国的样子，
sentences.traditional: 旁邊還有白色的老房子，這是幾百年前中國的樣子，
sentences.pinyin: páng biān hái yǒu bái sè de lǎo fáng zi zhè shì jǐ bǎi nián qián zhōng guó de yàng zi
sentences.english: If you don’t want to be too exhausted, you can also enjoy the yellow and red trees at the foot of the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 电影《卧虎藏龙》里就有这些房子和树。
sentences.traditional: 電影《臥虎藏龍》裡就有這些房子和樹。
sentences.pinyin: diàn yǐng wò hǔ cáng lóng lǐ jiù yǒu zhè xiē fáng zi hé shù
sentences.english: Besides the trees, there are also old white houses, which is how China looked hundreds of years ago.
The movie “Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon” shows these houses and trees.

sentences.simplified: 如果想去中国西边找秋天，可以去成都。
sentences.traditional: 如果想去中國西邊找秋天，可以去成都。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ xiǎng qù zhōng guó xī biān zhǎo qiū tiān kě yǐ qù chéng dū

sentences.simplified: 成都是一个火辣的城市，如果你怕热，那在秋天去成都是最好的选择。
sentences.traditional: 成都是一個火辣的城市，如果你怕熱，那在秋天去成都是最好的選擇。
sentences.pinyin: chéng dū shì yí ge huǒ là de chéng shì rú guǒ nǐ pà rè nà zài qiū tiān qù chéng dū shì zuì hǎo de xuǎn zé
sentences.english: If you want to go to western China to look for autumn, you can go to Chengdu.

sentences.simplified: 成都的秋天不像夏天的那么热，天气舒服极了。
sentences.traditional: 成都的秋天不像夏天的那麼熱，天氣舒服極了。
sentences.pinyin: chéng dū de qiū tiān bú xiàng xià tiān de nà me rè tiān qì shū fu jí le
sentences.english: Chengdu is an extremely hot city. If you can’t stand the heat, then going to Chengdu during autumn is the best option.

sentences.simplified: 这时去成都一定要吃一次火锅。
sentences.traditional: 這時去成都一定要吃一次火鍋。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí qù chéng dū yí dìng yào chī yí cì huǒ guō
sentences.english: Chengdu’s autumn isn’t as hot as summer. The weather is extremely pleasant.

sentences.simplified: 成都火锅很好吃，但是有点辣。
sentences.traditional: 成都火鍋很好吃，但是有點辣。
sentences.pinyin: chéng dū huǒ guō hěn hǎo chī dàn shì yǒu diǎn là
sentences.english: If you go to Chengdu during this time, you must go and eat hotpot.

sentences.simplified: 这时候的成都市里有很多漂亮的树，黄的、绿的、红的……
sentences.traditional: 這時候的成都市裡有很多漂亮的樹，黃的、綠的、紅的……
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou de chéng dū shì lǐ yǒu hěn duō piào liang de shù huáng de lǜ de hóng de
sentences.english: Chengdu’s hotpot is really tasty, but it’s a bit spicy.

sentences.simplified: 如果不想在市里玩，可以去爬雪山，但是别忘了多带一些衣服。
sentences.traditional: 如果不想在市裡玩，可以去爬雪山，但是別忘了多帶一些衣服。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ bù xiǎng zài shì lǐ wán kě yǐ qù pá xuě shān dàn shì bié wàng le duō dài yì xiē yī fu
sentences.english: Chengdu during this time has lots of beautiful trees: yellow, green, and red …
If you don’t want to stay in the city, you can go and hike in the snow-capped mountains but don’t forget to bring extra clothes.

sentences.simplified: 东、西、南、北，每个地方的秋天都不太一样，
sentences.traditional: 東、西、南、北，每個地方的秋天都不太一樣，
sentences.pinyin: dōng xī nán běi měi ge dì fang de qiū tiān dōu bú tài yí yàng

sentences.simplified: 除了这三个地方，中国还有很多地方的秋天都很漂亮。
sentences.traditional: 除了這三個地方，中國還有很多地方的秋天都很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: chú le zhè sān ge dì fang zhōng guó hái yǒu hěn duō dì fang de qiū tiān dōu hěn piào liang
sentences.english: East, west, south, and north … the autumn in each place is different.

sentences.simplified: 如果有时间，可以去更多的地方看看。
sentences.traditional: 如果有時間，可以去更多的地方看看。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ yǒu shí jiān kě yǐ qù gèng duō de dì fang kàn kan
sentences.english: Other than these three places, China also has lots of other places where autumn is very beautiful.

sentence_translations: China Autumn Travel Map
Autumn is a special season. It doesn’t have the passion of summer, but it has a different color.
It doesn’t have the quietness of winter, but its weather makes people feel comfortable.
What is autumn like in China? Let’s take a look at the following cities.
If you want to look for autumn in China, you should not miss Beijing.
Autumn in Beijing is very famous. Many people have written about Beijing’s autumn.
In autumn, the sky in Beijing is very blue and very high, and the weather is neither cold nor hot.
So many people will go hiking during this time, and Beijing’s Fragrant Hills are the top choice.
The trees in the Fragrant Hills turn red in autumn. The red trees and the blue skies are incredibly beautiful.
The Forbidden City is also great.
During this period, students have returned to school for classes, so there aren’t too many people visiting the Forbidden City.
You should not miss the beautiful and tranquil Forbidden City.
Autumn in the south is also very beautiful. You can go to Huangshan to have a look.
Huangshan is in Anhui, which is in southern China.
In China, there is a saying: After visiting Huangshan, you won’t want to climb any other mountains.
This is because Chinese people consider Huangshan to be the most beautiful mountain in China.
Huangshan is very high. There are many special trees and rocks on the mountain.
The clouds on the mountain are also incredibly beautiful, like the sea.
Standing on the mountain and watching the sea of clouds is a must-do activity when visiting Huangshan.
If you don’t want to be too exhausted, you can also enjoy the yellow and red trees at the foot of the mountain.
Besides the trees, there are also old white houses, which is how China looked hundreds of years ago.
The movie “Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon” shows these houses and trees.
If you want to go to western China to look for autumn, you can go to Chengdu.
Chengdu is an extremely hot city. If you can’t stand the heat, then going to Chengdu during autumn is the best option.
Chengdu’s autumn isn’t as hot as summer. The weather is extremely pleasant.
If you go to Chengdu during this time, you must go and eat hotpot.
Chengdu’s hotpot is really tasty, but it’s a bit spicy.
Chengdu during this time has lots of beautiful trees: yellow, green, and red …
If you don’t want to stay in the city, you can go and hike in the snow-capped mountains but don’t forget to bring extra clothes.
East, west, south, and north … the autumn in each place is different.
Other than these three places, China also has lots of other places where autumn is very beautiful.
If you have time, you can go and see even more places!
